summary: Steel tower, 30 m (98 ft), built 2019 per Alberta Wildfire's layer; active with fly access, and a closed MERX tender titled with its name. No source describes it today.

access.note: Active, staffed Alberta Wildfire lookout. The layer codes access mode as fly. No source found says the public may visit.

events.note: Present steel tower, per the Alberta Wildfire lookout layer

notes_for_editor: Facts come from the provincial layer (record PA, location NOT verified by the layer, verifier listed as GPS), so the mapped point may be approximate. The MERX notice is closed and the cached page holds only its title and page furniture: no buyer, date or scope is shown, so the story does not name an agency or give a replacement year. The 2019 date is the layer's, not the tender's. A search snippet gave a legal land location for the tower that does not appear on the fetched page, so it is not used. No source describes the site today beyond the layer's active status. No photos or staffing history found.
